rules.statement: clk_i is the only clock in the design.
TL-UL and strap inputs are sampled and all outputs change only at the rising edge of clk_i, except for the effect of rst_ni.
i_gpio may change at any time relative to clk_i.
The test bench must change i_gpio only synchronously to clk_i, like the other inputs.
rst_ni is active-low reset, asserted asynchronously and released synchronously to clk_i.
While rst_ni is 0, every register holds its reset value given in the gpio specification register tables.
